en: Reverse side of a World War I-era field postcard (Feldpostkarte). The card is filled with dense handwritten text in a Central European language using Latin script, oriented vertically on the left half. At the top left there is a sender address mentioning "Čilipi, Süd-Dalmatien". The right half has preprinted lines for the addressee, written to "Sl. Božena Vobořilová" in "Vlašim, Böhmen". A circular military postmark with the word "ČILIPI" and the date is partially visible, and there are purple and blue overprints/handwritten marks including a large blue signature-like word across the stamp area. The card number "3404" is printed at the bottom right.
